errors.text: The proposed intervention does not reconstruct the target high-energy ball milling plus spark-plasma-sintering process.
The intervention is not operationally specified: alloy composition, precipitation treatment, temperatures, times, and target precipitate size or volume fraction are absent.
The predicted outcome lacks quantitative, measurable changes relative to the untreated baseline.
The experiment does not verify that coherent nanoprecipitates were actually formed, so a negative mechanical result could not distinguish failure of the mechanism from failure of processing.
